name: AnythingLLM
description: The all-in-one AI app for any LLM with full RAG and AI Agent capabilities.
requires:
Before installing, you must create the following files: 
        - `touch .env` at /mnt/user/appdata/anythingllm/.env (see https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/blob/master/docker/.env.example for an example) 
        - `touch anythingllm.db` at /mnt/user/appdata/anythingllm/anythingllm.db

paths.name: Environment File Path
paths.description: Path to the environmental variable file. File must exist before running!

paths.name: Storage Path
paths.description: Storage for databases and file storage

variables.name: In-container storage path
variables.description: In-container storage location. Do not change!
